issue.title: Crash on checkout after updating to 4.2.0

state.body:
### What happened
After deploying build 2026.09.17-rc2 to staging, calls to `POST /v2/orders/{id}/split` return HTTP 500 for orders that have gift options enabled but an empty gift message. Orders without gift options split fine.

### Stack trace
```
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "String.trim()" because the return value of "com.globex.orders.model.GiftOptions.getMessage()" is null
    at com.globex.orders.split.SplitService.copyGiftOptions(SplitService.java:203)
    at com.globex.orders.split.SplitService.split(SplitService.java:117)
    at com.globex.orders.api.OrderController.split(OrderController.java:88)
```

### Expected
Split should succeed and copy gift options to each child order.

### Notes
Prod is still on 2026.09.10 and is unaffected as far as we know. Support has not reported anything. Splits are used by the warehouse team for backorders, a few dozen times a day.

comments.author: j.okafor
comments.text: I think this came in with #4402 (gift options refactor). Before that we wrapped the message in Optional.ofNullable.

comments.author: m.chen
comments.text: Workaround for the warehouse: untick gift options, split, then re-enable on each child. Tedious but works.

pull_request.title: Add rate limiting to public search endpoint
pull_request.author: s.nakamura
pull_request.description:
## Summary
Adds a token-bucket rate limiter (60 req/min per API key) to `GET /search`. Returns 429 with a Retry-After header when the bucket is empty.

## Why
We saw scraping bursts last week that pushed search p99 over 4s.

## Testing
- [x] Unit tests for TokenBucket
- [x] Integration test hitting /search until it returns 429
- [ ] Load test in staging (planned after merge)

## Rollout
Behind flag `search_rate_limit`, default off.

## Notes
Also bumped the Redis client since the old one lacked the EVALSHA helper we use.

diff_summary.change: new TokenBucket using a Redis Lua script
change default page size from 20 to 50
